item.title: Spokane Wildfires Destroy Hundreds of Buildings as Thousands Evacuate

item.title: Trump Administration Is Undoing Plans to Boost Workplace Heat Protections
item.description: The Biden administration took steps to shield workers from extreme temperatures. The Trump administration is taking a gentler approach with employers.
item.dc:creator: Scott Dance
item.category: American Federation of Labor-Congress of Industrial Organizations
item.media:description: A delivery in Wilmington, N.C., this month. Heat is linked to hundreds of workplace deaths each year, but labor groups say the true toll is unknown because heat-related illnesses are not properly tracked or reported.

item.title: Extreme Heat Has Transformed What Summer Means Across Generations in Europe

item.title: Japan’s Rescuers Battle Cruel Heat After Major Earthquake

item.title: Summer of Heat, Fires and Storms Is a Reckoning for Europe on Climate
item.description: The continent is experiencing some of its biggest fires and highest temperatures ever. Residents are fleeing, leaders are struggling to respond and “it will get worse,” one climate expert said.
item.dc:creator: Mark Landler and Chico Harlan
item.media:description: Firefighters using controlled burns to stop the spread of wildfires near Madrid on Tuesday.

item.title: Even the Rich Can’t Escape Cyclospora, Ticks, Heat Waves and Other Summer Scourges

item.media:credit: Clockwise from top left, Angela Weiss/AFP — Getty Images; Alex Kent/The New York Times; Elizabeth Cecil for The New York Times; Michelle V. Agins/The New York Times
